name: Algebraic Recurrence Obfuscation
description: Rewrites the standard max(A, B) flow-shop recurrence into an algebraically equivalent but structurally obscure difference-based accumulation $S_2 = S_2 + \max(S_1 - S_2, 0) + p_2$. It replaces the "zero out other jobs" wording with explicit binary indicator masks. Models that just pattern-match the standard flow shop will fail to recognize the equivalence and either TLE by simulating $O(N^2)$ mask combinations or fail to find the $O(N)$ reduction, while models that algebraically reduce the recurrence will easily find the $O(N)$ solution.
